descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A4 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Text contrast below WCAG AA in several places (survey button 3.66:1, Previous Notes header 2.5:1, dashboard room line)

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-06/S24a, TC-13/S22, TC-25/S21

Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S18 Both dashboards pass axe, and the counts sit in a live region

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T2 The Nursing Home dashboard reuses the Hospital dashboard design (SOW Exhibit B) (TFA-92598 AC 2; TFA-92598 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3; TFA-92598 How it works 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Standard fixture; visual lane screen hospital-dashboard (exists) and nh-dashboard (to add)

When Visual lane runs axe-core WCAG 2 A/AA on both dashboards, plus a DOM check on the element that holds the four tiles

Then No serious or critical violations. The tiles have readable label/number pairs, each patient row is a button named with the patient's name, and the tile container has aria-live (polite) or role=status, so a count change is announced (WCAG 4.1.3)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core results (visual-checks.ts): zero serious or critical. A separate DOM check, because axe does not flag a missing live region: the element containing the Total/Pending/In Progress/Complete tiles has aria-live='polite' (or role='status'), and the tile numbers are inside it (main has aria-live='polite' on the dl). …

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-92598 in progress

On both dashboards the room / pending-task line and the status pill are too low in contrast to read easily (they fail WCAG AA).

Evidence: allure-results/9b6f2679…: visual lane, 12 pass / 6 fail on desktop, iPhone 15 and Pixel 7. axe: the room / '1 task pending' line (#90a1b9) and the status pill fail AA contrast on both dashboards. The live region and patient-named row buttons pass.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S18

Tickets: TFA-92598 Rounding Dashboard (in progress)

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: partly): lists.spec.ts: both dashboards; axe serious/critical; live region around the four tiles with the numbers inside; row buttons named with the patient. — Whether VoiceOver/TalkBack actually announces a change is S20b (a person with a screen reader).

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 12 judged check(s) passed, 6 failed. The tiles sit in a live region (aria-live=polite on the dl) with the numbers inside; each row is a button named with the patient.

Product issue: Contrast: the '1 task pending' / room line (#90a1b9) and the status pill fail AA on both dashboards (oracle: zero serious/critical).
